name: bento
description: Your Bento tables, analyses and dashboards in Claude; add transactions by asking.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your Bento's MCP endpoint with a Bento API key. A read key lets Claude look at tables, rows, dashboards and forms and run analyses; a read-write key also lets it add and change rows. It never changes the schema and never deletes anything. Every call is listed in Bento under Connections → Claude.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A Bento API key (Connections → API keys). Read keys only read; read-write keys may also add and change rows.
